I've set up the weekday 17:30 "Pod end of day" job, but it probably won't post today. I replied to June in her thread on #strategic-pod to say so.

- **Gateway:** The Hermes gateway isn't running, so the job is saved but won't fire until someone starts it.
- **Time zone:** The scheduler uses the server clock (UTC), not Chicago time. It currently shows its next run as 17:30 UTC on 2026-10-23, not today. Someone needs to start the gateway and confirm the time zone.
- **Delivery:** The job's output is saved locally only. When it runs, the job posts the note into #strategic-pod itself. It uses only that channel's messages.
